metadata.source: Test-only PMS v11; pinned weapons/animations/objects from simulation manifest.
metadata.controlRole: authoritative: original BOT authority with Dummy=true disables AI; adapter restores original HUMAN held-trigger gating before the server cooldown step. Legacy fixtures default to unmodified HUMAN.
metadata.humanControlExpectation: Pinned Control.pas:555-569 resets BurstCount when Fire is released; FireMode=2 holds the cooldown above zero after the first shot while Fire remains held. One trigger hold emits one firing action, not one projectile (Eagles/Spas emit multiple).
metadata.commandTiming: Commands at tick N are applied after completing step N and before its recorded state, affecting step N+1.
limitations: Seed values and trajectories are captured; policy equivalence is within each RNG policy, not equality between original and keyed.
